title: PlayStation 5 销量突破 1 亿台
content:
PlayStation 5 ships 100 million consoles
Console
Business
News
PlayStation 5 crosses 100 million consoles sold
The 2020 console has exceeded 100 million consoles shipped, matching much of the PlayStation console line.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
,
GameDeveloper.com
November 11, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
via PlayStation
Newsbrief:
As of November 10, 2026, PlayStation 5 has reached the milestone of 100 million consoles shipped, according to
Sony Interactive's Business Data & Sales page
. The milestone has been
imminent for some time now
, but crossing the 100 million threshold puts the PlayStation in line with the PlayStation, PlayStation 2, and PlayStation 4.
The only other home consoles that shipped above 100 million units were the Nintendo Wii and Nintendo Switch, putting the PlayStation 5 in rare company.
